digest.component_or_area: link command and causation edge validation
propositions: The caused_by link relation accepts any target without validating that the target has a referencing commit, causing misattributed edges and unreliable metrics.
The referencing commit scan implementation exists only in close_precheck._referencing_commits and must be hoisted to a shared module to gate both link_core and _link_dry_run identically.
A caused_by link to a commit-less target must be refused unless --force is provided, with the refusal shown in previews and the escape hatch available on CLI, library, and MCP interfaces.
The referencing commit check must apply to the resolved target itself, not its descendants, to prevent hierarchy-promoted misattribution through epic children.
Unverifiable targets (no code repo or no git history) must allow the link, distinguishing from invalid (target provably has no commit).
The force parameter must follow claim-style spelling with a shared extract_force parser and be recorded in the store for audit traceability.
